unblocking: Restore the execution environment's egress access to the EBI summary-statistics host and rerun with the identical parameters of job mr-20260928172951-be648ce5e994 or mr-20260928174429-43846ceb1fa8.
Or configure OpenGWAS credentials (this runtime reports opengwas_token_missing) and switch to OpenGWAS dataset identifiers; this changes the source identifiers and requires user confirmation.

Or configure the isolated hosted MR adapter and switch to local summary-statistics files downloaded from the two consortia's official release pages, with the exposure instruments pre-clumped and accompanied by a provenance statement.

Note: restoring network access alone is not sufficient for the source as specified, because GCST006900 itself has no harmonised file; that accession path must be replaced by a study of the same trait that has a harmonised file, or replaced by the local-file route above.
